securityAssessment: Order-support click calls the existing fixed https://t.me/ObsidianSupBot target synchronously. No order ID, text query, clipboard read/write, API call or money action is in that path.
Optional copy is an explicit separate button; unavailable, insecure, malformed, rejecting or throwing clipboard reports manual-copy guidance without diagnostic leakage or legacy fallback.
Escaped order IDs remain literal in new attributes and existing captured data; no new string-to-JavaScript sink was introduced.
Success feedback follows actual browser promise settlement; throwing haptics cannot turn success into failure. Detached DOM receives no late success and pending order-ID writes are serialized.

The deployment recipe changes only one fixed HTML target, requires exact old/new and gate input hashes, retains fsynced rollback preimage and atomic replacement, and refuses an active autopilot. It does not mutate services or database state.
limitations: This is a bounded diff review; it does not certify the full existing application or close E4/earlier gates.
Telegram navigation is a same-turn spy assertion; no real support request/message, customer API/data, money, credentials, signing or 064A operation was performed by this reviewer.
Actual Telegram, iOS/WebKit, human comprehension and screen-reader announcements remain unverified.

A submitted native clipboard write is not cancellable; the lock governs order-ID copies only, and a stalled write blocks further order-ID copies while support stays usable. Other application/OS clipboard producers remain outside that lock.
This is a predeployment review; actual rollout/runtime verification remains the primary agent responsibility.
